title: ficaria verna subsp. calthifolia
intro: Ficaria verna subsp. calthifolia, commonly known as lesser celandine, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the family Ranunculaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory actions. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including isobutylamides and other alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and spasmolytic properties. Ficaria verna subsp. calthifolia has been traditionally used as a natural remedy to soothe various ailments, including digestive issues and skin conditions, such as eczema and acne.
